about:
Idaho Shirtsmith Custom Apparel & Embroidery was founded in 2022 in Nampa, Idaho, by Zack and his team. The company began as a local shop focused on providing custom apparel and embroidery services to businesses across the state.

The shop offers screen printing, digital transfer printing, commercial embroidery, and premium laser‑engraved leather patches, along with a range of promotional products such as bags and drinkware. Since opening, the team has completed over 1,000 custom orders for more than 100 businesses, operating from a single facility in Nampa.

Idaho Shirtsmith serves Idaho‑based companies across various sectors, including mechanical contractors like Metalhead Mechanical, as well as other local businesses needing branded apparel and promotional items. Customers range from small shops to larger organizations looking for custom uniforms or merchandise.

The company emphasizes a collaborative design process, providing fast quotes and working with clients until the artwork is approved, then delivering high‑quality apparel on schedule. It also highlights its use of top‑tier blank brands to ensure durability and comfort.
